'''Parl''' was an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] officer who served in the [[Investigations/Legends|Investigations]] branch. Alongside fellow officer [[Huorne]], the pair engaged in a series of gambits against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] that made them famous.
